notes: Generated-vase LootJS modifier replaces the normal block drops.
LootEntry conditions including randomChance are not evaluated; all listed items are possibilities, not guaranteed contents.
The modifier declares three independent pools with variable roll counts; item frequencies are not simulated.

provenance.description: Reachable structure loot tables extracted read-only from installed Minecraft/mod resources and KubeJS datapacks. KubeJS takes precedence over jar resources; same-priority conflicts are marked unresolved.

table._comment: This is for legacy purposes, because beyond earth used this in their structures for some reason, so I can't remove it.
